WITH project_rates AS (
  SELECT s.arcref AS project_reference,
         p.fundflux AS funding_source,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS size_per_minute_rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(size_per_minute_rate) AS avg_project_rate
  FROM project_rates
)
SELECT pr.project_reference,
       pr.funding_source,
       pr.size_per_minute_rate AS rate,
       pr.size_per_minute_rate - b.avg_project_rate AS gap_above_benchmark
FROM project_rates AS pr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE pr.size_per_minute_rate > b.avg_project_rate
ORDER BY gap_above_benchmark DESC
LIMIT 10;
